custom-mudlet-speedwalking-package.name: custom-mudlet-speedwalking-package

DarkMistsCompanion.name: DarkMistsCompanion

mechanisms.routing: raiseEvent dmapi.communication.tellreceived/tellsent -> ChatHistory MiniConsole tab (msgType 'tell', green)

mechanisms.routing: raiseEvent dmapi.communication.newbiechannel -> ChatHistory MiniConsole tab (msgType 'newbie')

mechanisms.routing: capturePlayerList walks backwards from getLineNumber() via moveCursor/getCurrentLine, matches player rows ^%[[^%]]+%], selectCurrentLine()+copy2decho() to copy the COLORED lines, and WhoWindow.console:decho() them into 'Who List' Geyser.MiniConsole tab; optionally deleteOriginalLines from main window (setting whoWindowDeleteOriginalLines)

mechanisms.routing: parses AFF output line, deleteLine() gags the original from main window, records the affect and renders into 'Current Affects' Geyser.MiniConsole tab via console:cecho/cechoLink
mechanisms.notes: Capture+gag of the 'affects'/AFF command output into a separate tab (Geyser.UserWindow-capable). Guards prompts & combat-condition lines.

mechanisms.routing: onRoomNameColor -> dmapi.parsers.captureRoomName(); captures the room-name line (bright-yellow FG) into the mapper/room-state parser, not a chat window
mechanisms.notes: Trigger group 'DM Core'. Room-name capture by ANSI foreground color for mapping/awareness.

mechanisms.notes: Room exits capture for mapping. Also note colorizer trigger 'Colored Directions' ((?i)\b(north|east|south|west|up|down), regexCodeProperty 1) gated by Lua condition 'dmapi.core.state.capturingRoom' recolors exit directions inline (isColorizerTrigger=yes) - recolor, not window capture.

DarkMistsCompanion.notes: Large Dark Mists companion (config.lua version 1.5.10, author Mudzereli). No GMCP/MSDP/ATCP (classic ROM/Diku MUD) - all capture is via a single always-on raw-line hook (onNewLine, Lua 'return true') that funnels every line through handleCommunicationLine() Lua string.match parsers, which raise dmapi.communication.* events. A hand-rolled chat framework (ChatHistory) subscribes to those events and cecho's timestamped, per-channel-colored messages into a Geyser.MiniConsole inside an Adjustable.Container tab ('Chat History', channels All/OOC/Direct/Local). Additional tab captures: WhoWindow (who list, copy2decho + optional deleteLine), AffectsWindow (AFF output, deleteLine gag). Room name/exits captured for the mapper via a color trigger and a regex trigger. sysDataSendRequest is used only for a SpamPrevention module (outgoing command dedupe), not text capture. assets/ contains HTML/JSON item DB and docs (non-runtime).

mechanisms.routing: when ddesc.capturing, ddesc.parseLine(line) regex-extracts keyword/location/status from the raw line into ddesc.entries table, then rendered into a separate miniConsole 'ddescWindow' via decho (openWindow/renderEntries); optional deleteLine() gag is commented out (inactive)
mechanisms.notes: Captures the 'dd list' (dynamic character-description list) output, not chat. Trigger type 0 = substring match on 'Keyword  :'; script reads the whole `line` variable and parses keyword/location/status with line:match(). Safety tempTimer(3s) finalizes and renders the window.

mechanisms.routing: selectString(line,1)+copy2decho() copies the full colored line, delayScrolling.add(str) stores it in delayScrolling.buffer, deleteLine() gags the original from the main window; a 100ms timer replays one buffered line at a time via dfeedTriggers back into the main console (color-preserving delayed scroll)
mechanisms.notes: Captures EVERY incoming line (regex ^(.*)$, match property 1 = perl regex), not chat-specific. Gag+buffer+re-feed to slow scrolling. Buffer capped at getConsoleBufferSize(). Toggle via 'delay on|off' alias; trigger disabled around dfeedTriggers to avoid re-capturing the replay.

demonnicAutoWalker.name: demonnicAutoWalker

Its own output is cecho'd to the main console (status/usage/perf report). No game-text capture.

dice.name: dice
dice.no_capture_reason: Pure alias package (diceroll/dicemin/dicemax) + a Lua script doing math.random. No triggers, no GMCP, no window routing.

mechanisms.notes: regexCodeProperty integer=1 (perl regex). Also detects tick and Quiet-mode from same line.

mechanisms.routing: deleteLine() gags the line; echo("promptWindow", "\n <AFK> \n") into the promptWindow miniConsole
mechanisms.notes: regexCodeProperty integer=2 (begin-of-line substring).

discworldquowmaps.name: discworldquowmaps
discworldquowmaps.no_capture_reason: Standalone GMCP-driven graphical mapper: gmcp.room.info handler (registerNamedEventHandler 'QuowMain'/'RoomInfo') looks up the room in an sqlite DB and renders a PNG map tile into a Geyser.Label via a compiled quow_pulse.so/.dll canvas. Has one tempRegexTrigger '^There are (.*) obvious exits: (.*)$' but it only re-triggers GMCP negotiation, it does NOT capture the exit text into any window. dpstest.name: dpstest
dpstest.framework: hand-rolled (no window UI; internal stat tables + cecho reports)

mechanisms.notes: regexCodeProperty integer=1. Auto-starts a session on first hit.

mechanisms.routing: NOT window-routed: flags next-hit crit multiplier in internal state (DPS.flagCrit).
mechanisms.notes: Plus regex triggers for logout stop, balance/equilibrium regain (internal timing only).

mechanisms.routing: NOT window-routed: named event handlers build DPS.entitiesById id->name map and current target snapshot to attribute damage segments per enemy. No text shown in any window.
mechanisms.notes: registerNamedEventHandler('DPS',...). Persists to dpstest/dps_data.json. Included for provenance; this package routes NOTHING to a separate window/tab/gauge.

DSL PNP 4.name: DSL PNP 4
DSL PNP 4.framework: hand-rolled (Geyser + custom windowManager + sidebar tab system; runtime tempRegexTriggers via dslpnp.triggers.register)

mechanisms.routing: Trigger raises onChat(matches[1],channel,text); handler process_text does selectCurrentLine()+copy()+appendBuffer into per-category chat miniConsoles (tabs All/Public/Clan/Private) and their backing buffers; deleteLine() if channel is in gag list.
mechanisms.notes: Master pattern is dynamically assembled from channel_patterns (say/whisper/group tell/tell/yell/shout/clan gossip/gossip/ask/answer/bloodbath/auction/quest/ooc kingdom/kingdom/ooc clan/clan/ooc/grats/radio/thaxanos/shalonesti/conclave/newbie/pray/broadcast/imm). Separate extra triggers added for kingdom/conclave/thaxanos/shalonesti/broadcast. Registered at runtime as tempRegexTrigger.

mechanisms.routing: process_text(): selectCurrentLine(); copy(); for each configured channel category containing this channel (or 'all') -> appendBuffer(chatWindow) + appendBuffer(chatBuffer); deleteLine() if channel in configs.gag. Tabs are Geyser miniConsoles + createBuffer backing stores.
mechanisms.notes: Category tabs: {All},{Public: yell/shout/clan gossip/gossip},{Clan: ooc clan/ooc kingdom/clan/kingdom},{Private: group tell/say/tell/whisper}. Clickable sidebar tabs switch active console (adjust_windows re-copies buffers).

mechanisms.routing: Raises onCombat('damage',...); handler reformats the hit and cecho()s it into the 'battle_console' miniConsole, then deleteLine() gags the original combat line (unless show_damage). Condition triggers ('X is in excellent condition'/'is DEAD!!') feed battle_console window_condition too.
mechanisms.notes: Damage verb ladder maps hit words to damage magnitude; also Evade/Flag/Condition regex triggers -> onCombat/onCondition. battle_console added via windowManager.

mechanisms.routing: User-invoked line grab: selectCurrentLine()+copy()+appendBuffer('history_list') (and its buffer), prefixed with a timestamp, into a 'history_list' miniConsole so players can keep important MUD lines.
mechanisms.notes: Manual capture-to-window feature (not auto-triggered). Also a generic Window_Manager.lua provides appendBuffer autowrap windows; Affects.lua/Gourd.lua create affects_list/gourd_list miniConsoles for defence tracking (not chat).

earthshaker-aetolian-curing-system.name: earthshaker-aetolian-curing-system
earthshaker-aetolian-curing-system.framework: hand-rolled Geyser (tabbed Geyser.MiniConsole chat consoles + Geyser.Label tabs; not EMCO/YATCO)

mechanisms.routing: Central capture routine called by every chat trigger: selectString(line,1); copy(); appendBuffer('chatAll'); if not All -> appendBuffer('chat'..Title(channel)); deleteFull() gag if cgag[tab]; flashes the tab's Geyser.Label. Tabs are Geyser.MiniConsoles created in initChat (chatconsoles table).
mechanisms.notes: Console tabs: All, Say, Tells, City, House, Web, Guild, Market, Shouts, Clans, Death, Status. echoChat invoked with channels: all, say, tells, city, house, web, guild, market, shouts, clans, death, combat, hnt, league, mariners, pisces, teachers. A legacy 'Old Chat' trigger group (isActive=no) held equivalent copy()+appendBuffer('chatall'/'chatweb'/'chatguild'/'chatcity'/'chathouse'/'chatmarket'/'chattells') logic.

mechanisms.routing: echoChat("say") -> copy()+appendBuffer into chatAll + chatSay miniConsoles
mechanisms.notes: isColorTrigger=yes with colorTriggerFgColor #800080 (purple) plus the regex list; conditionLineDelta 39.

Sibling triggers: House (^\((House Bouchard|Bouchard Primii)\)...) -> chatHouse; Web (filter trigger, ^\((Web)\)...) -> chatWeb; Market -> chatMarket; Clans (^\(((.+))\)\:...says) -> chatClans; Guild (^\((\w+)\)... / ^<<(\w+)>>...) -> chatGuild.

mechanisms.notes: isColorTrigger=yes fg #800080. Covers newbie channel + yells/shouts to the All tab.

mechanisms.routing: echoChat("death") -> chatAll + chatDeath miniConsole
mechanisms.notes: Death/deathsight channel capture.

MapContents/MapBottom likewise copy each ASCII-map row into the 'map_window' Geyser.MiniConsole and deleteLine() gag; MapBottom disables MapContents.
mechanisms.notes: 3-trigger gated sequence capturing the in-game ASCII map block into a dedicated map miniConsole (map_window created as Geyser.MiniConsole).

mechanisms.pattern: gmcp.comm.channel (handler onChannel: if gmcp.comm.channel.isooc then decho ooc msg into ooc_window)
mechanisms.routing: decho(ansi2decho(gmcp.comm.channel.msg)) into ooc_window Geyser.MiniConsole (side panel); also deleteLine() gags the matching OOC line from main buffer when RPMode on
mechanisms.notes: Event handler on gmcp.comm.channel; only routes when channel.isooc is true. Destination ooc_window MiniConsole created in 'sidepanel' script (line 1073).

mechanisms.routing: decho(ansi2decho(gmcp.comm.tell.msg)) into ooc_window Geyser.MiniConsole
mechanisms.notes: OOC tells only (gmcp.comm.tell.isooc); stored in comms.last.otell for the gag trigger to match.

mechanisms.routing: deleteLine() gag - removes OOC channel/otell lines from the MAIN buffer when RPMode is on, by matching normalized current line against comms.last.ooc / comms.last.otell
mechanisms.notes: Match-all perl regex (regexCodePropertyList=1). Gagging companion to the GMCP-fed ooc_window so OOC text only shows in the side console during RP mode.

mechanisms.routing: EMCO tabbed MiniConsoles inside an Adjustable.Container (demonnic.container); each console name is a chat tab; allTab='All' mirrors everything
mechanisms.notes: This package is the FRAMEWORK/destination only - it ships NO triggers or GMCP handlers matching game chat lines. Default tabs: All/Local/City/OOC/Tells/Group. User is expected to write triggers calling demonnic.chat:append('tab'). Aliases manage tabs/gags/theme.

mechanisms.pattern: getCurrentLine(); selectCurrentLine(); copy(); console:appendBuffer(); allTab:appendBuffer(); if self.gag then deleteLine()
mechanisms.routing: EMCO:append(tabName) copies the current game line (with color) into the named tab's MiniConsole plus the All tab; optional deleteLine() gag + gagPrompt tempPromptTrigger removes it from main; :cecho/:decho/:echo(tab,msg) feed arbitrary text
mechanisms.notes: Canonical YATCO/EMCO-style capture: selectCurrentLine+copy+appendBuffer. matchesGag/addGag mute lines by pattern; sendNotification per tab; bufferSize 10000/deleteLines 500.

mechanisms.routing: ChatCaptures(): selectCurrentLine, colorize by channel, copy(), deleteLine() to gag from main window, then appendBuffer('ui.ChatMC') (Geyser MiniConsole in Chat tab) + appendBuffer('ChatBuffer') for rewrap
mechanisms.framework: hand-rolled Geyser (Muddler/DeMuddler build; descendant of ErionUI 1.0)
mechanisms.notes: Match type integer 1 = Perl regex on all patterns. Central chat routing helper ChatCaptures() at Chat_Functions script line 31.

mechanisms.routing: ChatCaptures(keyword, false): copy + deleteLine() gag from main, appendBuffer('ui.ChatMC') + 'ChatBuffer'
mechanisms.notes: Same routing helper as ChatCapture; deletes captured line from main window.

mechanisms.pattern: ^\[GUESS\] | ^The phrase is | ^\[Expedition\] | ^Your personal Guess the Phrase is | ^Achievement Unlocked \-\> | ^QUEST\: | ^EXPEDITION\: | ^JUNKYARD\:

mechanisms.notes: bDeleteLine=true path keeps line visible in main plus mirrors to chat tab.

mechanisms.routing: selectCurrentLine(); copy(); appendBuffer('MainBuffer') - mirrors ALL main-window output into an offscreen wrap buffer used for reflow on resize
mechanisms.notes: Catch-all '^' regex fires on every line; feeds the resize/rewrap system, not a visible chat tab.

mechanisms.routing: clearWindow('ui.ExitsMC'); selectCurrentLine; copy(); ui.ExitsMC:appendBuffer(); replaceLine('') to gag from main; also stashes exits into generic_mapper map.prompt.exits

mechanisms.routing: parses ~30 stat vars, deleteLine() to gag raw prompt, raiseEvent GUI_UpdateStatus / GUI_UpdatePrompt / GUI_UpdateMapName which cecho into StatsMC/StatusMC MiniConsoles and setValue on hpbar/enbar/phpbar Geyser.Gauges
mechanisms.notes: Custom Aardwolf-style '#1%h#2%H...' prompt set via SetDefaultMudSettings; drives all gauges and stat panels.

mechanisms.routing: selectCaptureGroup(1); copy(); ui.AnsiMapMC:appendBuffer(); replace() - moves the in-band ANSI map rows into the AnsiMapMC MiniConsole and blanks them from main
mechanisms.notes: Group ANSI_Map_Capture also has Map_Cleaner (^ {13})(!C|-) and Map_Spacer (\(Id .+[^)]\)) cleanup triggers.

mechanisms.routing: selectCurrentLine(); copy(); appendBuffer('MainBuffer') - mirrors every main-window line into offscreen wrap buffer for resize/rewrap
mechanisms.notes: Match type integer 1 = regex. Original package by Caelinus that ErionMud-UI derives from.

mechanisms.routing: selectCurrentLine + deleteLine() to gag raw prompt; deleteLine on MainBuffer; raiseEvent GUI_UpdateStatus/GUI_UpdatePrompt/GUI_UpdateMapName which cecho into StatsConsole/StatusBar MiniConsoles and setValue on hpbar/enbar Geyser.Gauges
mechanisms.notes: Custom prompt 'prompt #1%h#2%H...' set in SetMudSettings.

mechanisms.routing: selectCurrentLine; copy(); deleteLine() to gag from main; appendBuffer('ChatLog') (Geyser MiniConsole) + appendBuffer('ChatBuffer') for rewrap
mechanisms.notes: 22 channel regexes; deleteLine can be commented out to keep line in main.

mechanisms.routing: CleanScoreBuffer(); selectCurrentLine; copy(); appendBuffer('ScoreBuffer'); moveCursorDown('ScoreBuffer')
mechanisms.notes: mStayOpen=16 keeps trigger open across the score table; captures into ScoreBuffer.

mechanisms.routing: clearWindow('ExitsConsole'); selectCurrentLine; copy(); ExitsConsole:appendBuffer(); replaceLine('') to gag from main
mechanisms.notes: Redirects exits line into ExitsConsole MiniConsole.

mechanisms.notes: ANSIMapCapture group also has Map Cleaner and Spacer cleanup triggers.

mechanisms.pattern: ^Your comm unit signals a tight beam message from (\w+), "(.+)$ | ^Your comm unit crackles with a message from (\w+), "(.+)$ | ^(\w+) (says|asks), "(.+)$ | ^There is a brief hum from your comm unit\.$ | ^\w+ doesn't seem to be around at the moment\.$
